article.headline: Max Alexander, Jonas Nichols propel Houston Christian to 87-76 victory over South Dakota
article.description: — Max Alexander scored 26 points, Jonas Nichols added 25 and Houston Christian beat South Dakota 87-76 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Max Alexander, Jonas Nichols propel Houston Christian to 87-76 victory over South Dakota

event.description: Houston Christian Huskies @ South Dakota Coyotes

keywords: Houston Christian Huskies @ South Dakota Coyotes
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Max Alexander scored 26 points, Jonas Nichols added 25 and Houston Christian beat South Dakota 87-76 on Tuesday night. Alexander shot 8 for 12 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 7 of 11 from the free-throw line for the Huskies (3-0). Nichols made 10 of 14 shots with three 3-pointers. Mambourou Mara pitched in with 10 points, 10 rebounds and four blocks. Kajus Kublickas led the Coyotes (1-3) with 16 points. Josiah Dotzler contributed 15 points, six assists and two steals. Vince Buzelis finished with 11 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
